+import html
+import pytest
+
+from mistune import create_markdown
+from mistune.directives import RSTDirective, FencedDirective, Admonition, Image, Figure, Include, TableOfContents
+
+
+CASES = [
+    ("note", Admonition, "Custom", [("class", "extra")], "**body**\n"),
+    ("image", Image, "cat.png", [("alt", "cat"), ("align", "left"), ("height", "12"), ("width", "2em"), ("target", "/go")], ""),
+    ("figure", Figure, "cat.png", [("alt", "cat"), ("align", "center"), ("height", "12"), ("width", "2em"), ("target", "/go"), ("figwidth", "80%"), ("figclass", "extra")], "caption\n\nlegend\n"),
+    ("include", Include, "child.txt", [("encoding", "utf-8")], ""),
+    ("toc", TableOfContents, "Contents", [("min-level", "2"), ("max-level", "3"), ("collapse", "")], ""),
+]
+
+
+def source(kind, title, options, content, fenced):
+    lines = "".join(":" + key + ": " + value + "\n" for key, value in options)
+    if fenced:
+        return "## Heading\n\n```{" + kind + "} " + title + "\n" + lines + "\n" + content + "```\n"
+    return "## Heading\n\n.. " + kind + ":: " + title + "\n" + "".join("   " + line + "\n" for line in lines.splitlines()) + "\n" + "".join("   " + line + "\n" for line in content.splitlines())
+
+
+def make_md(factory, fenced, strict):
+    kwargs = {} if strict is None else {"strict_options": strict}
+    if fenced:
+        directive = FencedDirective([factory()], **kwargs)
+    else:
+        directive = RSTDirective([factory()], **kwargs)
+    return create_markdown(plugins=[directive])
+
+
+def render(md, text, tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "child.txt").write_text("included", encoding="utf-8")
+    path = tmp_path / "source.md"
+    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
+    return md.read(str(path))[0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", CASES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fenced", [False, True])
+def test_supported_options_keep_their_behavior(case, fenced, tmp_path):
+    kind, factory, title, options, content = case
+    text = source(kind, title, options, content, fenced)
+    assert render(make_md(factory, fenced, True), text, tmp_path) == render(make_md(factory, fenced, False), text, tmp_path)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", CASES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fenced", [False, True])
+def test_unknown_option_reports_first_name(case, fenced, tmp_path):
+    kind, factory, title, options, content = case
+    text = source(kind, title, options + [("bogus-first", "x"), ("bogus-second", "y")], content, fenced)
+    result = html.unescape(render(make_md(factory, fenced, True), text, tmp_path))
+    assert 'Unknown option "bogus-first" for directive "' + kind + '"' in result
+    assert "bogus-second" not in result
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fenced", [False, True])
+def test_legacy_and_non_directive_behavior(fenced, tmp_path):
+    text = source("note", "Custom", [("bogus", "ignored")], "body\n", fenced)
+    ordinary = source("note", "Custom", [], "body\n", fenced)
+    default_md = make_md(Admonition, fenced, None)
+    assert render(default_md, text, tmp_path) == render(default_md, ordinary, tmp_path)
+    strict = make_md(Admonition, fenced, True)
+    expected = make_md(Admonition, fenced, False)
+    assert strict("```python\nx = 1\n```\n") == expected("```python\nx = 1\n```\n")
